derivation.material_from: tools/pbr_author/stems/nextgen_fungi.classes.json, the classes the authoring agent chose per stem by reading the art
derivation.bands_from: the pipeline's per class defaults in tools/pbr_bake.py (pbr_review_from_defs.bands)
notes: planks is the authoring tool's refinement of wood and is recorded as wood.
metalness_policy follows the authored _s: predominant where over a fifth of the texels carry the metal byte, partial where some do.
tiles is false for skins and model textures listed in the stems .mobs.txt file.

nextgen_fungi_mushroom_brown.rationale: The class the Nextgen Fungi authoring agent chose for this stem on 2026-10-05 after reading its art (tools/pbr_author/stems/nextgen_fungi.classes.json, leaves). The bands are the pipeline's leaves defaults, not a per texture judgement.
